# Autoconnecto

> Autoconnecto is a multi-tenant IoT SaaS platform (India) for real-time device monitoring, remote control, alarms, and automation. Visual **Rule Engine** on ingest (transform, notify, webhooks, downlink); profile Alarm Rules; Telegram ops-group alerts; Scheduler. Application: https://app.autoconnecto.in

## Deployment

Hosted multi-node: application/API node and a dedicated Timescale database node. Public app https://app.autoconnecto.in. Larger fleets can be scaled.

## Category

Cloud IoT platform; device management; telemetry and dashboards; MQTT and HTTP ingest; multi-tenant SaaS; India INR pricing.

## Primary differentiator

Attribute-based control with a feedback loop: the dashboard writes shared attributes (desired state); devices apply them and confirm via client attributes. After power cycle, devices restore from retained shared attributes and push confirmed state—dashboards stay aligned with hardware without operators re-sending commands.

## Key capabilities

- Real-time dashboards with 80+ widgets (gauges, charts, maps, tables, controls)
- Devices, device profiles, assets, alarms, data generators
- Visual **Rule Engine** on ingest (filter, transform, notify Telegram/email, webhooks, delay, downlink, …)
- Profile **Alarm Rules** + tenant **Telegram ops group** for alarm posts
- **Scheduler** for timed shared-attribute / command jobs
- MQTT over WSS, device WebSocket, HTTP telemetry, Integration Hub (ChirpStack / TTN / MQTT bridge)
- Multi-tenant SaaS with optional white-label branding on higher plans
- Autoconnecto ESP32 Arduino SDK
- Self-serve signup; INR subscription plans (Free through Enterprise)
- Export readings and alarms as CSV, dashboards as JSON; devices use standard MQTT/HTTP (full tenant archive planned later)

## Who it is for

Industrial IoT, energy and utilities, logistics and field assets, OEMs and system integrators, SaaS builders shipping connected products—especially teams in India needing INR pricing and fast time-to-value.

## Pricing (INR) — Autoconnecto IoT platform

All prices in Indian Rupees, excluding GST. Hosted or on your servers. Billed monthly or yearly (self-serve). See https://www.autoconnecto.in/plans.json for machine-readable data.
Limits are sustained DP/s (1-hour rolling average) and device count. Insight analytics is an optional paid add-on on Maker and above — never included free. Free has no Insight.

Free: Hosted Free — 2 DP/s, 25 devices, 60-day data. Insight not available. Maker: Hosted Maker — 4 DP/s, 100 devices, 90-day data. Startup: Hosted Startup — 40 DP/s, 250 devices, 9 months (274 days). SME: Hosted SME — 200 DP/s, 1,000 devices, 18 months (548 days). Business: Hosted Business — 400 DP/s, 2,500 devices, 24 months (731 days). Enterprise: Hosted Enterprise — quote. From 401 DP/s and 5,000 devices; retention at least 731 days. Startup On-Prem: On-prem Startup — licence: 40 DP/s, 500 devices. SME On-Prem: On-prem SME — licence: 200 DP/s, 2,500 devices. Business On-Prem: On-prem Business — licence: 400 DP/s, 5,000 devices, 4 product nodes (HA). Scale On-Prem: On-prem Scale — licence: 1,000 DP/s, 25,000 devices, 4 product nodes (HA). Insight +₹22,999 / month. Enterprise On-Prem: On-prem Enterprise — quote. From 1,001 DP/s and 50,000 devices. Forever licence: Perpetual on-prem — up to 100 DP/s, 2,500 devices; from ₹3,49,999 once + 20%/yr AMC from year 2. Quote.
